title: ‘Bumtak Sara ti Nuangen’ turns OFW dreams into a village-wide spectacle
summary: Among the 19 student short films competing at the CinePanalo Film Festival 2026, "Bumtak Sara ti Nuangen" stands out as the student shorts lineup’s only comedy, camp, and satire entry.
